events.description: Roosevelt understood the camera before most politicians did. He posed in buckskin in the Badlands, stood with John Muir at Yosemite, and left behind one of the most photographed lives of his century. The special exhibition, drawn from his book In the Room, opens at the Library in October.

events.title: Girlfriend Getaway 2027
events.description:
About the Girlfriend Getaway

The Girlfriend Getaway was created from a simple belief: women need spaces where they can reconnect with themselves and with each other.

So many of us spend our days caring for everyone else. Managing it all. Showing up for everyone around us. Somewhere along the way, it gets easy to lose touch with ourselves.

This is now our fourth year gathering, and every time, the same thing happens. Women who don’t know a single soul in the room leave feeling like they’ve found their people.

Three days at the Rough Rider Hotel in Medora, ND. Speakers who share real stories, not polished performances. Small group conversations. Time built in just for you: a massage, a facial, reiki, whatever kind of care your body and heart are asking for. And plenty of open space too, to wander Medora, find a coffee shop, read a book, breathe.

You don’t have to come with a plan. You don’t have to come with friends. You just have to come as you are.

If this is your first time, welcome. You’re exactly where you’re meant to be. If you are returning, we can’t wait to see you again.

Ready to grab your spot? Tickets and all the details are linked above. And be sure to tap Going or Interested so you don’t miss updates as we get closer, we’ll be sharing more in the Discussion tab along the way.

events.title: 11th European Heart Congress
events.description:
The 11th European Heart Congress, taking place on August 09–10, 2027, in London, UK, is a premier international platform dedicated to advancing heart health, cardiac research, innovative therapies, advanced diagnostics, interventional procedures, and patient-centered cardiac care. The congress will bring together cardiologists, heart specialists, interventional specialists, cardiac surgeons, electrophysiologists, heart researchers, physicians, healthcare professionals, academicians, pharmaceutical and biotechnology experts, medical device specialists, and healthcare technology innovators to exchange knowledge, research, clinical experiences, and emerging developments in heart medicine and cardiac care.

Under the theme “Heart Health in a New Era: Innovation, Precision Medicine & Advanced Cardiac Care,” the congress will explore the rapidly evolving landscape of heart health and cardiac medicine, focusing on precision medicine, advanced heart diagnostics, innovative treatments, minimally invasive procedures, digital heart health, artificial intelligence, heart disease prevention, and personalized approaches to cardiac care. The scientific program will address major areas including coronary artery disease, heart attacks, acute coronary syndromes, heart failure, hypertension, cardiomyopathies, heart valve disease, arrhythmias, electrophysiology, structural heart disease, cardiac imaging, preventive heart care, congenital heart disease, and emerging cardiac therapies.
